rows.phase_or_construction: Galaxite-derived liquid association reference from open primary crystal thermochemistry; the liquid standard is constructed below its peritectic interval.
rows.method: Assemble product-positive standard Gibbs terms with the existing condensate phi evaluator.
rows.uncertainty_note: The heat-capacity fit is extrapolated above its measured range and the formation enthalpy is assessed rather than directly measured. Chen activity data were held out and did not select the equilibrium constant.
range_flags: Galaxite melts peritectically near 2000 K; the liquid association standard is constructed from crystal data.
The primary DSC heat-capacity fit is measured through 873 K and extrapolated to the melting interval.

provenance.source: Navarro et al. (2012) and Navarro, de Avillez, Goes, and Gomes (2020) primary galaxite heat-capacity and entropy measurements, plus Ilatovskaya and Fabrichnaya primary phase-equilibrium measurements
provenance.selection_rationale: Galaxite is included from open primary crystal thermochemistry. Its Gibbs function uses the measured Cp fit and S°298.15; no primary formation enthalpy exists, so the assessed -39.5 kJ/mol oxide-formation value is used with ±12.6 kJ/mol uncertainty. Below fusion, the Tier 3 entropy and Cp spreads use the maximum measured residual among liquid-reference spinel homologues MgAl2O4 and Mg2TiO4 (N=2). The MgAl2O4 homologue now uses Shornikov et al. (2017), Table 2, ΔfusH=55.81±4.62 kJ/mol at retained JANAF Al-090 Tm=2408 K, with JANAF Al-089 crystal and Al-090 liquid Cp. Its corrected shared Tier-3 mean and homologue spread are recomputed; the MgAl2O4 leave-one-out residual is 65.033 kJ/mol and controls the galaxite homologue envelope. The central galaxite Gibbs function remains derived from galaxite thermochemistry. No Chen activity data were used to choose the row. Held-out summary: all_three: median ratio 5.770, out-of-band 55/55; without_MnSiO3: median ratio 9.543, out-of-band 55/55; without_Mn2SiO4: median ratio 6.153, out-of-band 55/55; without_MnAl2O4: median ratio 7.202, out-of-band 55/55; MnSiO3_only: median ratio 7.615, out-of-band 55/55; Mn2SiO4_only: median ratio 14.756, out-of-band 55/55; MnAl2O4_only: median ratio 11.404, out-of-band 55/55; no_complexes: median ratio 17.733, out-of-band 55/55; These comparisons use the held-out Chen datasets after MnO solid-to-liquid reference conversion; no equilibrium constant was tuned to them.

accuracy_band.coverage: Sum of the constructed galaxite band, including its crystal formation-enthalpy and entropy uncertainties, the MnO(l) band, and the existing Al2O3(l) supercooled-reference band.
